build_gaussian_dataset_iterator: build a batch iterator that yields random Gaussian data samples with configurable batch size and input dimension
create_matching_gaussian_data_generator: create a fake input generator that produces scaled Gaussian noise matching the shape of input batch data
compute_variance_kl_divergence: compute the KL divergence between two Gaussian distributions given their variance and predicted log variance
generate_batched_forward_with_state: generate batched ENN network outputs for multiple random indices using vmapped forward passes with state
build_regression_prior_loss: build a regression prior loss function that regularizes fake data towards the prior and optionally distills mean and variance
